faq.title: A few useful answers.
faq.q1: How do I choose a mentor?
faq.a1: Start with the field you need help in. Read their profile, compare the consultation formats and prices, and describe what you want to discuss.
faq.a2: Payment uses a manual transfer where available. Follow the instructions on your booking and submit the transaction reference. A submitted reference is reviewed before payment is confirmed.
faq.q3: Where can I find my booking?
faq.a3: Open My bookings in the same browser you used to book. Current booking access is tied to that browser; keep your booking ID and contact support if you need help.
